artwork.placement_after: The cow lowered her head and took another mouthful.
“STAIRS! A sacred escalation device! Make way!”
Sagar took one step sideways to find their faces. Neet adjusted toward the bush. Heather held her smile. “We could photograph the backs of their heads. They’re very committed.”
Buddy wriggled. “Noooo my trail seasoning!” Then he saw the open car door and offered the next paw. Cool air required sacrifices.

observations: Every current finished image opened at full resolution against original photos; concrete findings recorded per image.

observations.humor_and_voices: The organized outing repeatedly follows dog priorities. Neet uses approval/security language and creates a delay by trying to pass Buddy; Buddy actively pursues guest-book access and committee trees, then chooses cool air over trail seasoning. Sagar supplies logistics and the successful private recall phrase; Heather supplies nurturing practical redirection and the backs-of-heads suggestion. Buddy is exuberant here but remains distinct from Neet through smell/comfort priorities rather than rank rhetoric.
observations.cause_effect_and_timing: Snack movement earns attention, attempted passing crosses leads, failed portrait orientation requires the private phrase, and heat reverses Buddy tree and wipe preferences. Cow indifference punctures Neet alarm; the calmer return earns the distant approval callback. Clean-paw repetition follows the first permitted wipe and ends with an actual change of paw. No explanatory text is needed to repair these causal links.
image_placement: Cow v005 occurs after the cow lowers her head to graze and before the road bend ends barking: visible distant grazing cow, barking Neet, watching Buddy and supporting human hand match this exact state. The replacement slim tail remains legible and no reader-level regression is visible.

Stairs v005 occurs after stairs discovery and before the family surges upward. Buddy nose at bark versus Neet on steps looking back makes the competing priorities readable; separate leads fit the resumed expedition after the prose tangle. It does not falsely depict the subsequent climb.

Photo v004 sits after Heather proposes backs-of-heads and before the magic phrase. Neet faces the left bush, Buddy turns to the right, the foreground camera seeks their faces and Heather keeps smiling. It preserves the later successful-photo reveal.

Paw v003 follows Buddy offering a paw for cool air and precedes the same-clean-paw repetition. Wipe contact, open car, travel bowls and waiting Neet communicate the bargain. Buddy gaze angles toward the open doorway/human side; prose carries the exact invisible cool-draught motivation.
observations.complementarity: Four scenes contribute alarm versus indifference, incompatible walking priorities, failed group portrait and comfort-driven cooperation. Viewpoints and settings change across car interior, trail, overlook and parking lot; no duplicate portrait padding. Cafe, heat and home prose remain readable between illustrations.
observations.emotional_payoff: The unpictured home ending gives the story space to settle through specific lunch, daytime string lights and siesta. The final checklist addition recalls the leash tangle without replacing the warm family landing. A fifth sleep image is unnecessary.
observations.provenance: Rendered footer retains dated editorial selection, unverified owner approval/chronology, archive source hash and historical refinement note. These are provenance, not present acceptance authority.
